item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. There's a refill check-in on the schedule, plus a checkpoint later to review progress on your tracking tools. Medication only works if the system around it works — refills on time, doses tracked, nothing left to memory. Don't let a busy day push the small logistics to tomorrow. Action: when that refill call comes up, actually make it, don't reschedule it.
